comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented a six-file ESM tree with CLI, data, app, and entry modules after local probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The child completed and returned its CLI findings before the parent wrote the implementation; the parent continued with probes and file edits.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results; all observations stayed in the parent trajectory from probe through final verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a result-return lifecycle, but no needed result was trapped, cancelled, or left unjoined in a way that harmed delivery.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel shared workspace risk did not materialize because implementation writes were centralized in the parent; serial had no shared-state boundary.
